readout.summary: Watch list. Both models that cover this noon ET game at Prudential Center make Seton Hall (6-1, 5-0 at home) a heavy favorite over Siena (5-2): Dimers gives the Pirates a 93.6% win probability (Seton Hall -2500, Siena +1300) and projects 85-67, and SportsGambler projects 84-64. Neither recommends the side; both lean Under on the total (Dimers Under 156.5, SportsGambler Under 155.5), and Dimers puts Seton Hall's chance of covering -17.5 at 50.5%. Seton Hall comes in on a three-game win streak after a 73-27 rout of New Hampshire; Siena beat Vermont 98-88. The one availability item: Seton Hall's Devin Williams (quadriceps) was listed day-to-day and questionable for this game in a Nov 24 report.
